prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: High fidelity mobile app redesign presentation, board 1 of 3, FreshWise 菜鳥不買貴. Create a polished, production plausible Traditional Chinese / Taiwan mobile app design, based on this existing app's actual functionality: a food price advice app, not ecommerce. Today, browse market prices, item detail, basket and settings; no checkout or ordering. This board shows TODAY / BROWSE / ITEM DETAIL.
Composition: landscape design board, request 3840x2160 resolution or highest available. Three large complete straight-on mobile screens side by side, identical scale, ~430:900 aspect ratio. Keep clear generous gutters but maximize UI legibility. Tiny heading upper left 'FreshWise' and '菜鳥不買貴 · UI／UX redesign'. Warm off-white background. Slim rounded screen outlines, no large physical phone bodies, no perspective, no hands, no lifestyle backdrop. Small dark green captions above screens '01 今日', '02 行情', '03 品項詳情'. Footer outside phones exactly '介面示意・價格為示範資料，非即時行情'.
Design system: fresh editorial grocery aesthetic, warm white #FAFAF6 background, solid forest #214F3B typography, main green #36885B, mint #EAF2E9, muted sage grey secondary copy, thin soft grey dividers, amber estimate badges, brick red prices UP and green prices DOWN with arrows and text. Warm light yellow small seasonal accents. Large bold price numerals, crystal clear Traditional Chinese sans-serif Noto Sans TC, excellent hierarchy and contrast. 8pt spacing system, 20px horizontal padding, 16-20px radius cards, 44px minimum tap targets. Modern simple outlined navigation icons, consistent stroke. Limited tasteful realistic cutout vegetable photos (cabbage, broccoli, carrot) on pale organic background. No emojis, no ornamental leaf spam, no gradients, no glassmorphism.
Shared context: all prices illustrative, date '2026/11/20', never claim current live data. Retail venue '傳統市場', market '臺中市・全部市場', unit '元／台斤'. Collapsed context selector under page header. Four bottom tabs exactly '今日', '行情', '我的菜籃', '設定'. Active tab green shape+label, inactive grey. Status bar time 9:41. All major screen text in Traditional Chinese, not simplified.
Screen 1 TODAY: header small FreshWise and brand '菜鳥不買貴'. Context row pin icon '傳統市場' and '臺中市・全部市場' with chevron, beside small unit pill '台斤'. Subtle info row '11/20 資料 · 尚未更新至今日'. Spacious dark forest green hero card after selector, friendly title '今天，高麗菜可以買', subtitle '比過去 90 天平均便宜 20%', smaller '實際訪價', a beautiful cabbage cutout at right, price '18' and '元／台斤'; clear short CTA '看價格詳情 →'. Two small stats below in hero '↓ 18 項降價' and '↑ 8 項漲價'. Compact search field '搜尋食材或常用名稱'. One line of six category icons and labels '蔬菜' '水果' '漁產' '肉類' '蛋品' '糧食', no wrap. Section '今天值得買' with '看全部 →'. Two rich but compact row cards: '高麗菜' small season tag '當季' price '$18' unit '/ 台斤' green '↓ 12%' and '青花菜' price '$42' green '↓ 8%'. Section '我的菜籃' with '3 項已填份量 · 估算 $102' and link '查看菜籃 →'. Bottom nav today active. Do not overcrowd.
Screen 2 BROWSE: header '行情'. Context row same market+unit. Small date row same. Search '搜尋食材或常用名稱'. Single horizontal category tabs '全部' '蔬菜' '水果' '漁產' '肉類' with 蔬菜 selected. Efficient filter toolbar with two compact controls '推薦排序 ⌄' and sliders icon '篩選 2'; selected filter chips '當季 ×' '實際訪價 ×'; no repeated giant tab rows. List heading '蔬菜行情' and '12 項・元／台斤'. Small instruction '點 ＋ 加入我的菜籃'. Five vertically spacious divider rows, each has cutout produce thumbnail at left, name and useful second line, right bold numerical price with visible unit, direction change text, far right circular '+' or check control. Rows: 高麗菜 $18 ↓12% / 青花菜 $42 ↓8% / 白蘿蔔 $22 ↓5% / 胡蘿蔔 $30 ↑3% / 小白菜 $28 ↑6%. Add amber '估算' badge to a sixth lower partial row 香菜 $65 ↑10% if space, but note selected actual-only filter would exclude estimate, SO DO NOT add an estimated row here. Above bottom nav a small source note '資料來源：臺中市零售市場訪價'. Bottom nav 行情 active.
Screen 3 ITEM DETAIL: top back chevron and title '高麗菜' with small subtitle '甘藍' and secondary more icon. Context row '傳統市場 · 臺中市' and '台斤 ⌄'. Small '11/20 資料 · 尚未更新至今日'. Hero price summary on clean white: cabbage cutout right, '實際訪價' outlined badge, big '$18' and '元／台斤', green '↓ 12% 較前一筆', text '比過去 90 天平均便宜 20%'. Below a subtle price range indicator labeled '過去 90 天價格區間' and endpoints '$12' '$38' with today marker '$18' positioned ~23% across. Section '哪裡買比較便宜', a compact white card with three aligned rows: '傳統市場' '$18／台斤' mint '較便宜'; '超市量販' amber '估算' '$24／台斤'; '批發行情' '$11／台斤' secondary '進貨參考'. Small visible note '批發價為進貨成本，非零售價'. Section '價格走勢', segmented '7 天' '30 天' '3 個月' '1 年', 30天 selected. A simple legible downward-trending green line chart, subtle grid, axis 11/01 and 11/20, label '$18'; source line '資料來源：臺中市零售市場訪價'. At bottom pinned primary green CTA '+ 加入我的菜籃' above safe area, without four-tab nav on this detail screen to prioritize action. No cropping or overlays. This is a real app screen, not infographic.
Constraints: Render exact Chinese labels carefully. Preserve trust cues, distinguish estimates, show units on every price context. No shopping cart checkout, no payment or delivery UI. Screen content must fit naturally and be internally coherent. Clear professional polished spacing.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: FreshWise 菜鳥不買貴 high fidelity mobile App redesign, board 2 of 3.
Input image: the supplied image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, the previous FreshWise redesign board. Match its visual system, typographic hierarchy, grocery photos, brand colors, corner treatment, bottom navigation, and polished clarity. This is a NEW design board of different screens, not a change to the original.
Primary request: design two large front-facing mobile screens side by side, '04 我的菜籃' on left and '05 編輯項目' on right. Landscape 2400x1800 or highest resolution available. Screen aspect ~430:880, same height, slim forest green screen outline with rounded corners, no heavy phone hardware, maximize sharp legible UI. Warm white board background; header FreshWise 菜鳥不買貴. Footer outside phones exact '介面示意・價格為示範資料，非即時行情'. Use Traditional Chinese Taiwan, Noto Sans TC sans-serif. Every numerical price itself forest green neutral, green arrows for down and brick red arrows for up. No arbitrary price numbers colored red. Palette warm white #FAFAF6, forest #214F3B, green #36885B, pale mint #EAF2E9, pale yellow accents, amber estimate pills. Flat clean cards with very restrained shadows. Realistic small vegetable photos and consistent outlined icons. 20px padding, clear 16px body text scale, 44px taps. Keep all important content readable.
Reference functionality from existing app: basket has user-defined groups, items, quantity in Taiwan jin, editable quantities/group, drag sorting, add items/groups. It is a price watch and budgeting tool, NOT a shopping checkout app. Never add checkout, payment, delivery, purchased checkboxes, budget progress bars or push notifications.
LEFT screen full basket, status bar 9:41. Page title '我的菜籃', subtitle '常買的菜，一次掌握價格', top right outline '編輯分類'. Context selector '傳統市場 · 臺中市' and '台斤 ⌄'. Information date '11/20 資料 · 尚未更新至今日'.
Dominant forest green summary card: small '今天買這一籃大約要', large '$102' beside small yellow '估算'; small exact '3 項計入・1 項未填份量'. Thin separator and clear white text '未填份量的項目不計入總額'. The total arithmetic must be coherent: cabbage 2台斤 ×18 =36, carrot 1台斤 ×30 =30, eggs 0.5台斤 ×72 =36; sum102. Broccoli unknown qty excluded.
First section '每週常買' and small '3 項', right pencil edit and drag dots. Three spacious list rows with tiny left drag grip, food photo, item name, secondary unit price, quantity pill, aligned subtotal:
'高麗菜' / '單價 $18／台斤' / quantity '2 台斤' / subtotal '$36' / small green '↓ 12%'.
'胡蘿蔔' / '單價 $30／台斤' / '1 台斤' / '$30' / brick '↑ 3%'.
'雞蛋' / '單價 $72／台斤' / '0.5 台斤' / '$36' / grey '持平'.
At end of this group outlined '+ 新增項目'.
Second section '想買的蔬菜' / '1 項', right pencil. One row photo '青花菜' / '單價 $42／台斤' / amber outlined quantity action '填份量' and subtotal '—'. Small supporting text '填寫份量後，才會計入總額'. At bottom low prominence '+ 新增分類'. Small source note '資料來源：臺中市零售市場訪價'. Bottom nav matching reference with '今日' '行情' '我的菜籃' '設定', basket active. Keep total card and actionable list visible, no overlays.
RIGHT screen shows THE SAME basket screen behind a dimmed scrim, overlaying a large clean white bottom sheet with rounded top corners, safe area; top visible background title '我的菜籃' and slightly dimmed green summary. Bottom sheet extends from upper-middle area to bottom (about 70% screen height). Top small drag handle; title '編輯項目' with close ×. Row large cabbage thumbnail, '高麗菜' and small '傳統市場 · $18／台斤'. Form label '常買份量'; large horizontal quantity stepper with outlined minus on left, big value '2', plus on right, trailing unit '台斤'. Two full sentences small text '1 台斤 = 0.6 公斤' and '也可以直接點數字輸入'. Label '所屬分類'; white bordered selector '每週常買 ⌄'. Clear mint subtotal preview: left '這項大約要' right '$36', secondary '2 台斤 × $18'. Fine print '依 11/20 行情估算，實際價格以攤位為準'. Spacious form vertical rhythm. Bottom left low-emphasis red text icon '刪除項目', bottom footer buttons '取消' outline and primary green '儲存'. Bottom sheet covers nav; no duplicate tab bar on sheet. Fully rendered complete sheet, no keyboard and no cropping.
Constraints: exact Traditional Chinese readable. Reference consistency. Same sample values across screens. No technical implementation language such as cookie or localStorage. Do not repeat other three screens of reference. No annotations/arrows over UI; two proper app screens.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: FreshWise 菜鳥不買貴 high fidelity mobile redesign, board 3 of 3.
Input image: provided image is the PREVIOUS DESIGN BOARD and is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Generate a NEW board, match visual language exactly: warm ivory, forest green type, restrained mint cards, outlined icons, clear Traditional Chinese. Do not duplicate the reference screens.
Primary request: polished full-height two-screen mobile App UI design board, landscape highest available resolution. Left screen caption '06 設定', right '07 選擇市場'. Two front-facing equal-scale 430:900 mobile artboards in slim rounded forest outlines with generous gutters on warm white board. Small top heading 'FreshWise 菜鳥不買貴'. Bottom board footer exact '介面示意・價格為示範資料，非即時行情'. No perspective/hardware/hands. Realistic app UI with readable Noto Sans TC Traditional Chinese and consistent icons. Solid forest #214F3B, main green #36885B, warm white #FAFAF6, mint #EAF2E9, thin sage grey borders, amber estimate indicators, no noisy decorative elements. 20px screen padding, 16px body labels, big clear headings, restrained 16px card radii. Tap areas >=44px.
Existing product behavior to respect: preferences default place/market/unit, show advice on homepage, threshold for highlighting large price changes (not notifications); data source transparency and device-local basket data management. Places exactly '傳統市場', '超市量販', '批發行情'; six external data sources; supermarket values are estimated. Four bottom tabs '今日' '行情' '我的菜籃' '設定'. No ecommerce, no premium plans, no account avatar, no push notification controls.
LEFT full SETTINGS screen:
9:41 status bar. Header '設定', subtitle '讓行情更符合你的買菜習慣'.
Section heading '買菜偏好'. White bordered card of clean rows separated by fine rules:
outlined store icon '預設場所' right '傳統市場 〉'
pin icon '預設市場' right '臺中市・全部市場 〉'
ruler icon '價格單位' right connected segmented switch '台斤' selected forest green and '公斤' inactive white.
Below card small quiet '1 台斤 = 0.6 公斤'.
Section '首頁與價格標示'. White card:
'顯示買菜建議' toggle ON green, below secondary '打開就知道今天適合買什麼'.
Second row title '大幅漲跌標示', description '超過門檻時，在行情中標示提醒'. Below horizontal four chips '10%' '15%' '20%' '30%', 15% active dark green. Very small clear text '僅影響頁面標示，沒有推播通知'.
Section '資料與來源'. White compact source summary card: '最新資料日期' right '2026/11/20', next row '公開資料來源' right '6 個 〉', next row '估算怎麼來的' right '查看說明 〉'. Amber info strip '超市量販為估算，非實際架上售價'. Another small muted line '蔬果等零售訪價以臺中市為主，糧價涵蓋 20 縣市'.
Section '資料管理'. Simple white card row '菜籃資料' with device icon and subtitle '保存在這台裝置，換裝置不會同步'. Two small text actions balanced '還原預設菜籃' neutral green and '清除全部資料' muted red.
Bottom nav 設定 active, inactive other icons+labels identical reference. Keep all content within usable viewport, no excessive microcopy.
RIGHT MARKET PICKER bottom sheet:
Same visual language; underlying dimmed TODAY screen shows brand title and market context only at top. White bottom sheet ~80% screen height with rounded top corners and handle, no nav over it. Header '選擇市場', close × top right, short text '先選場所，再選要看的市場'. Top full-width three segment control '傳統市場' selected / '超市量販' / '批發行情'. Search field with magnifier '搜尋市場名稱'. Amber soft contextual notice '零售訪價以臺中市為主'. Small neutral section label '臺中市'. Four market selection rows with generous 60px height, left location/store outline icon, name and small subtext, right SINGLE SELECT radio:
'全部市場' selected forest radio, mint background, supporting '顯示有回報市場的代表價'.
'建國市場' unselected, supporting '臺中市零售訪價'.
'第二市場' unselected, supporting '臺中市零售訪價'.
'第五市場' unselected, supporting '臺中市零售訪價'.
Names are example markets, not live data. No invented distances or ratings. Below quiet line '資料日期：2026/11/20'. Empty flexible space, then a compact neutral info box '價格會依你選擇的場所與市場更新'. Bottom fixed sheet footer two buttons '取消' outlined and green primary '確定'. Safe area padding. Only one selected radio. No keyboard.
Constraints: Render traditional Chinese exactly and with strong legibility. Preserve real trust distinctions and clear venue/market vocabulary. Organize source details as drilldown rows; no dense essay blocks. All important actionable sections visible. Do not introduce implementation terminology such as localStorage/cookies, no fake actual data or operational claims, no notification bell. Entire board exactly two screens.
